author: Cute master
description: The essential keyboard for large modpacks, official 5.0 update, 42 widget groups made just to satisfy your gaming needs. Base screen uses fully transparent material keys, clean and rigorous, with a sensible key layout; top center reserves space for Jade, top-right for the minimap; widget logic is clear, with newly added clear command sets and quick actions. Plus two full keyboards: center-screen full keyboard, pullable anytime, doesn't block normal gameplay; Full Keyboard Pro: 15 widget groups, two modes (full-key mode, combo mode); two grip schemes (four-finger mode, two & three-finger mode). Offers 4 blend methods, plus one function key set and two number key sets, supporting full layout coverage - fits large modpack layout needs. PVP keyboard: four-finger layout, quick item switch, quick bridging, strategist-level key arrangement, steady performance, unstoppable. Plus customizable dedicated mod keys to personalize your game.
